lead.headline: Likely's Friday miss is still the open question
lead.deck: No game status and nothing new by Saturday morning, so he starts. If he is inactive at 13:55, add Okonkwo for Diggs. Tuten is cleared.
lead.body: Bad news first: Isaiah Likely, your only tight end, did not practise Friday with a groin injury, and a Saturday-morning search found no update. The Giants gave him no game status and Harbaugh called it 'minor', so he starts. Chem's flex takes no tight end. If Jacksonville–New York inactives at 13:55 Sunday list him, add Chig Okonkwo (free agent, Washington, Monday night) and drop Stefon Diggs. Tuten practised on a limited basis Friday and has no game status. The lineup as set is the projection lineup; the one free improvement is Tuten to FLEX before noon.
